I could not verify the correct codimension from first principles, so this choice is tentative. My recollection of the literature on Coble surfaces and Pompilj automorphisms points to codimension 2, which matches Solution 1. Solution 2's Noether–Lefschetz argument gives codimension 1 only through an unjustified claim that both loci are cut out by a single condition. Solution 3 depends on a 9-dimensional moduli space and a rank-11 lattice count that I did not check, and its final codimension of 5 has no clear support.

CHOICE: 1
